description: Published desk notes, newest first: entry number, date (the day of the official action), published (the day the desk published the note), title, status, topic (cyber or sanctions), readers, source class, a one-line summary, and the note's URL. Pages with limit and offset; total is the count that matches, next_offset the offset of the next page. Filter by topic or reader as on the desk page.

offset.description: How many matching notes to skip, for the next page.

reader.description: Only notes written for this reader: sanctions-trade-finance-committee (Sanctions or trade-finance committee), owner-operating-executive (Owner or operating executive), platform-ai-stack-owner (Platform or AI-stack owner), deal-team (Deal team), credit-committee (Credit committee), cyber-underwriter (Cyber underwriter).

since.description: Only notes dated on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

topic.description: cyber (exploited vulnerabilities, advisories, incident filings, the AI stack) or sanctions (everything else).

name: list_notes
title: List desk notes
